name: Factorio Mod Localization Helper
author: neanimemeanime
description: A client-side web application designed for Factorio modders and translators. It analyzes a mod's .zip archive, intelligently parses .lua prototypes and .cfg locale files to find all missing localization keys, and generates a clean, comprehensive locale.cfg file ready for translation.
features: Advanced Lua prototype parser with support for complex rules
Cascade/Fallback logic for items and recipes
Detection of dynamic localization templates via recipe categories
Robust .cfg parser that filters invalid keys
Automated cleaner to remove vanilla Factorio keys
Generates a complete source .cfg, a mod-only `locale.cfg`, and a list of removed keys
